name: lazy-vibers-recipe
description: Model-agnostic interview pipeline that turns a raw product idea from a non-technical owner into a verified Blueprint Bundle (spec, data model, milestones, costs), then builds it. Seven skills: lvr-init-new-idea, lvr-continue, lvr-handoff, lvr-review-plan, lvr-add-feature, lvr-build, lvr-personal-brand.

interface.shortDescription: Idea to verified Blueprint Bundle, then build
interface.longDescription: An interview pipeline that turns a raw product idea into a verified Blueprint Bundle (spec, data model, milestones, costs) with disk-based state and evidence-first research, then executes the milestones.
defaultPrompt: Use $lvr-init-new-idea to start a new product idea.
Use $lvr-continue to resume my LVR project.
Use $lvr-build to build the next milestone.
